## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Telecommunications Technical Officer or Technologist to join our team and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance telecommunications infrastructure. This role is responsible for the design, installation, maintenance, and optimisation of complex communication networks and systems across a range of technologies. The ideal candidate brings solid hands-on technical experience, strong analytical capability, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. This position suits a proactive professional who is committed to maintaining the highest standards of network performance and service delivery.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain microwave, satellite, telemetry, and other radio and electromagnetic communication systems, ensuring all equipment operates to specification and within regulatory requirements.
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve network faults, performance issues, and equipment malfunctions in a timely and effective manner, minimising disruption to services.
- Integrate telecommunications networks with computer hardware, software platforms, operating systems, databases, and peripheral devices to ensure seamless end-to-end functionality.
- Monitor the ongoing performance of complex networks and communication systems, identifying trends, anomalies, and areas for optimisation before they impact service quality.
- Plan and support the development of customer access network infrastructure, contributing to capacity planning, design reviews, and upgrade programmes.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation including inventory logs, equipment records, asset statuses, and communication policies, procedures, and quality standards in accordance with organisational and regulatory guidelines.
- Provide clear technical advice and support to internal stakeholders, project teams, and end users on telecommunications systems, configurations, and best practices.
- Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and external service providers to coordinate procurement, installation activities, and ongoing service delivery, whilst monitoring contractual performance and obligations.
- Support the design and optimisation of network architecture, contributing technical input to projects aimed at improving reliability, scalability, and performance.
- Conduct routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and equipment testing to ensure network integrity and compliance with applicable standards.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams on telecommunications projects, providing technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle from scoping through to commissioning and handover.

- A diploma, advanced diploma, or bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field; or equivalent industry experience in lieu of formal qualifications.

- Solid understanding of network protocols, telecommunications standards, and systems integration principles.
- Proficiency in configuring and troubleshooting network hardware, software, and associated technologies including switches, routers, and transmission equipment.
- Experience with network monitoring tools and fault management systems, with the ability to interpret performance data and take corrective action.

- Willingness to participate in an on-call roster or undertake out-of-hours work when operational requirements demand.

- Exposure to project management methodologies and experience contributing to telecommunications infrastructure projects.
- Knowledge of ITIL frameworks or experience working within a managed services or enterprise network environment.

Position: Formwork Carpenter – Multiple positions available
Location: South Australia – Adelaide and regional sites 
Salary: $75,000 - $85,000 per annum + superannuation (depending on experience)

Business overview 
Folton Pty Ltd is a South Australian civil construction company based in Adelaide. We deliver civil construction and earthmoving projects across metropolitan Adelaide and regional South Australia, with regular work in the renewable energy sector as well as general civil infrastructure. 

The role
We are seeking experienced and motivated Formwork Carpenters to join our growing construction team in South Australia. This is a full-time, ongoing opportunity for individuals who are committed to producing high-quality work while maintaining a strong focus on workplace safety.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
•	Assemble, erect, align and brace temporary wooden, metal, or prefabricated formwork systems for concrete foundations, walls, slabs, beams, columns, wing walls, staircases and other structures according to blueprints and specifications.
•	Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, sketches and specifications to determine dimensions and layout, including setting up and using grade lasers for accurate levelling and alignment of formwork.
•	Measure, mark, cut and shape timber, plywood or metal components to precise dimensions using hand tools and power tools.
•	Dig, level and prepare ground or trenches for footings and foundations.
•	Install ties, hardware, stakes and supports to ensure forms are secure, level and able to withstand concrete pressure.
•	Strip (dismantle) forms after concrete cures, clean, repair and maintain formwork for reuse.
•	Work safely and efficiently as part of a team on various construction sites across metropolitan Adelaide and regional South Australia.

Requirements for the candidate
•	Minimum of 2 years' recent experience as a Formwork Carpenter within the construction industry.
•	Certificate III in Carpentry or an equivalent qualification, or at least three (3) years of relevant full-time work experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
•	Demonstrated ability to read and interpret construction drawings, engineering plans and technical specifications.
•	Experience using hand tools, power tools, laser levels and other construction equipment.
•	Sound knowledge of traditional timber, modular and metal formwork systems.
•	Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality workmanship.
•	Strong understanding of workplace health and safety practices.
•	The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
•	Reliable work ethic with the flexibility to work across metropolitan Adelaide and regional South Australia as required.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, ongoing employment.
•	Competitive remuneration with above Award wages based on skills and experience.
•	Site allowances, overtime opportunities and applicable penalties.
•	Opportunities for ongoing training, professional development and career progression.
•	A supportive team environment with a strong commitment to safety and quality.

How to Apply
Please send your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience to resumes@folton.com.au. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

As a family owned and operated business we are committed to our people. At SWB, we prioritise our employees, promoting a supportive and inclusive work environment where every team member feels valued and has the opportunity to grow.

About the role

We are currently seeking a motivated Sales Representative to join our Statewide Bearings team Wind Energy Team in Dandenong!
In your role, you will be responsible for supporting growth of our Wind Energy division by delivering technical service solutions, undertaking maintenance activities both in the workshop and at third-party sites, providing engineering support, and coordinating workshop and onsite service activities, while providing an exceptional level of customer service and satisfaction to all SWB customers and internal stakeholders.

Position: Sales Representative (Industrial Products)

Location of work: 84 Greens Road, Dandenong South, VIC 3175

Employment type: Permanent, Full time.

Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus Superannuation.

•	Work closely with customers, engineers, and technical teams to assess equipment needs and recommend suitable products or system solutions.

•	Provide technical presentations and product demonstrations to prospective clients.
•	Prepare quotations, negotiate pricing, and manage the full sales cycle including order placement, contract negotiation, and delivery coordination.
•	Assist in preparing proposals, bids, projects and responses to RFQs.
•	Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshooting for clients.
•	Conduct routine inspections and maintenance to ensure optimal turbine performance.
•	Train clients and internal teams on operation and maintenance procedures.
•	Schedule jobs in house and with third party suppliers.
•	Control job schedules, timelines and deadlines.
•	Work at assigned Wind Farm or workshop locations as required.
•	Promote and deliver cost effective process, solutions and savings.

To be successful in the role the applicant will need:

•	A relevant bachelor’s degree (required).
•	At least one year of experience in a similar role
•	Strong technical understanding of industrial products, machinery, and mechanical systems.
•	he ability to interpret technical drawings & schematics, and complete detailed inspection & QA reports.
•	The ability to understand and respond effectively to customer needs.
•	Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
•	High level of experience in Microsoft Excel and Word.
•	A proactive, self – motivated, and highly organised with excellent time management skills.
•	A high level of professionalism.
•	Current Driver’s License.
•	Access to a Personal Vehicle for site travel (Essential).

If you are looking to join a supportive work environment where you can grow and become the best version of yourself, apply now and start your career with SWB!

To apply, please click on the “Apply Now” button and submit both your resume and covering letter.
